title: Yellow Pickled Peruvian Fromage Blanc Tiradito
description: A light and refreshing Peruvian dish featuring roasted fromage blanc, pickled vegetables, and a touch of yellow pepper sauce, perfect for a flexitarian meal prep
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to roast the yellow peppers
Place the yellow peppers on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes
Let the peppers cool down and then peel off the skin and slice them into strips
In a large bowl, whisk together the pickling vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper
Add the sliced cucumber, carrot, and red onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the pickling mixture
Let the vegetables pickle for at least 30 minutes
In a separate bowl, mix together the softened fromage blanc and chopped cilantro
To assemble the tiradito, place a scoop of the fromage blanc mixture on a plate, top with a few strips of roasted yellow pepper and some pickled vegetables
